title: Two-Storey House With Stair
summary: M3 executable fixture for cross-level residential authoring: two levels, raw-bundle stair, raw-bundle stair opening, raw-bundle railing, hosted openings, plan/section evidence, drawing-sheet output, and advisor/visual/export route evidence.

ui.claim: UI/Cmd+K affordances are mapped to the fixture, but no browser-authored exact-input run is claimed.

cmdK.claim: Cmd+K coverage is classified conservatively: stair, shaft/opening, railing, floor, wall, and room steps are mostly tool activators, while hosted opening actions are contextual commits with missing exact fixture parameters.

mcpCli.claim: The deterministic fixture is executable offline and can post the bundle to /bundles in live dry-run mode when a target model is supplied. Stair, slab opening, and railing remain raw bundle payloads, not typed MCP parity.

integrity.claim: Route evidence records validation, hosted opening integrity, stair/slab opening, and Advisor status for the committed fixture.

advisor.claim: Advisor and validation evidence is collected from the benchmark route contract or from live public model routes; it does not claim a browser-authored UI run.

rendererDiagnostics.claim: Plan, upper plan, stair section, 3D, and sheet context visual evidence records renderer-critical feature status; live browser diagnostics remain separate.

visual.claim: Plan, upper plan, stair section, 3D, and sheet context are validated through accepted server-side sheet raster evidence; this is not a browser screenshot claim.

export.claim: IFC/glTF manifest and sheet PDF route evidence is collected with two-storey stair geometry counts.

performance.claim: Runner evidence records deterministic execution timing; full browser interaction timings require a live isolated model run.

acceptance.claim: Scenario acceptance combines semantic diff, Advisor validation, visual, and export route evidence.

methodology.claim: Scenario evidence links source intent, command bundle, UI/Cmd+K traceability, Advisor, visual, export, and acceptance rows; first-class assumption/source-feature ledgers await a disposable sketch-to-BIM rehearsal.

remainingBlockers: Stair, stair-opening, and railing fixture steps are raw bundle commands rather than first-class typed MCP/CLI tools.
No browser-authored UI/Cmd+K run creates the exact fixture dimensions and produces an independent model snapshot.
Offline route-contract artifacts are deterministic evidence; live committed target evidence still requires --commit-live or --collect-committed-evidence against an isolated model.
